caption: The drawing features a large central rectangular area depicting three abstract floral forms painted in blue, with broad, sweeping brushstrokes suggesting petals and leaves on flowing stems. Each flower has a rounded, loosely defined shape, with the two on the left appearing slightly more compact and the one on the right more elongated. The flowers are connected by curving stems, and each has distinct pointed leaves or petal-like forms extending outward. Above this central area, outside the rectangle, is a line drawing in black ink or pencil of a jar with a label that reads "WM. ADAMS & CO. LTD., NEW YORK, LITTLE W. 12th ST., 2", as well as a simple linear design resembling floral motifs or tendrils on the body of the jar. The background of the entire composition is a pale beige or cream color, with the artist’s name, Yolande Delasser, inscribed in small letters at the bottom right corner within the rectangular area containing the blue flowers.
title: Jar
